name: Todoist

auth.keyHelp: Copy your personal API token from the Integrations settings; it has full access to your tasks and cannot be limited to read-only.

read.label: List tasks matching a filter (today, overdue...)

tested: mock; real service refused a fake key
notes: Current API is Todoist API v1 (https://api.todoist.com/api/v1/), which unifies the old Sync API v9 and REST API v2; the docs have a 'Migrating from v9' section and say endpoints are now lowercase (mixed case returns 404). The v9/v2 docs are 'still available for reference'. NOT confirmed from Todoist's own pages: shutdown dates for v9 and REST v2 (the sunset status of REST v2 was only seen in third-party material), so do not use v2. List endpoints are cursor-paginated (limit up to 200, default 50). The personal API token is found under Settings > Integrations (the page names this location; the exact tab label was not verified). A personal token cannot be limited; read-only is only possible with OAuth, whose scopes are task:add (add only), data:read (read-only), data:read_write, data:delete, project:delete, backups:read. OAuth authorize URL https://app.todoist.com/oauth/authorize and token URL https://api.todoist.com/oauth/access_token, but the user needs a registered app with a client secret, so signIn is left null. The 'who' value is full_name from GET /user. Official MCP server https://ai.todoist.net/mcp is documented with OAuth (also supports Dynamic Client Registration); a bearer-token option was not documented.
